description: Source code for WebSocket route dispatcher in Playwright, managing WebSocket interactions within browser contexts or pages, including event handling, API requests, and script injection.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteDispatcher

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up WebSocket route dispatcher, exposes binding, and injects mock WebSocket source script.

methods.description: Removes WebSocket route dispatcher and disposes associated resources.

methods.description: Sends message to the page via WebSocket.

methods.description: Sends message to the server via WebSocket.

methods.name: closePage
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection from the page side.

methods.name: closeServer
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection from the server side.
